entries.zh: 央求；恳托、代人求情
entries.en: to entreat, press with pleas; to intercede (interceder)

entries.zh: 说人情；替人关说说情
entries.en: to plead for another, speak in someone's favor; to make intercession

entries.zh: 求人情；请托人情、托门路
entries.en: to solicit another's favor or influence; to seek intercession

entries.zh: 提携；提拔扶持、代为出力
entries.en: to support and promote someone, take under one's wing

entries.zh: 提撕；提点警策、劝勉
entries.en: to admonish and exhort; to rouse or alert someone

entries.zh: 提挈；提携帮扶、引手提挈
entries.en: to lead by the hand and help along; to aid and support

entries.zh: 说方便；求宽便利、代为讨情
entries.en: to plead for leniency or accommodation; to intercede for favorable treatment

entries.zh: 解释；分说化解（疑难）
entries.en: to explain, interpret; to clear up or settle a difficulty
entries.notes: 西注 por dificultad，取解释疑难、化解义；M 栏并列两种读音。

entries.zh: 央托；恳托拜托
entries.en: to entrust a request by pleading; to ask someone's intercession
entries.notes: M 栏夹拉丁注 ut supra interceder（义为如上=interceder），照录不影响释义。

entries.zh: 央求；恳求哀告
entries.en: to entreat, implore; to beg earnestly

entries.zh: 牵荐；引荐美言、代为先容
entries.en: to recommend and speak well of someone; to bring forward another's cause

entries.zh: 出力相助；在公廷代为帮衬说项
entries.en: to help or aid by interceding; to assist (helping at court)
entries.notes: 助廷 组合罕见且 M 音 chan iēn 与汉字不尽吻合，据 L ayudar 及上下文取出力相助、公廷助力义。

entries.zh: 央得着人；凭交情托得动人办事
entries.en: to prevail on someone through friendship by pleading; to get a person to act by entreaty
entries.notes: 西注缩写 f.（或为 favor）展开不明，释义以汉栏央得着人与 M 音为准。

entries.zh: 鄙陋卑贱；鄙视、看不起
entries.en: despicable, contemptible; to despise
entries.notes: 西语词头 Yntelessable 无法可靠展开（疑为 interesable 或 insensable 之讹写），en 义项据汉字鄙与闽音 pi 推定。

entries.zh: 张开、伸展；张设铺张
entries.en: to stretch, spread out; to extend, display
entries.notes: 西栏空缺，据汉字張与闽音 tio 取铺张张开义。

entries.zh: 刁难；贪利故意作难（参贪心条）
entries.en: to make difficulties out of self-interest; one who acts only for profit; cf. covetousness

entries.zh: 传话；传译、通译（为通事）
entries.en: to relay or convey words; to interpret (an interpreter)

entries.zh: 解释；解开、分解
entries.en: to explain, interpret; to untie, undo
entries.notes: 西栏空缺，据汉字解与闽音释义；居传译条目之间，取解释义。

entries.zh: 通事；通译（官府或商务译员、居间人）
entries.en: interpreter; licensed go-between for official or trade dealings
entries.notes: 西注尾部 nagna tac 无法释读，核心释义据 Ynterprete、通事与 tong su。

entries.zh: 回话；回覆应答、代为传译回话
entries.en: to answer back, reply; to interpret back as a go-between
